what: flank-only beta step on the verified seats (question B of the flank-robustness task, 2026-10-17)

grid.fixed: every other parameter = rows/slipper-nose-knuckle-3r.json best_params as the verifier merges them (tools/slipper_env_polish.py full()), mu 0.087, nose_r 1.1839

readings.priced: CB_FOLD_MARGIN=5.5 (smlo + 0.5, stop B at bk1 + bk2 - 5.5)

protocols: verified: fit Bench(60,160) fast -> Bench(110,360) exact, flood on (tools/slipper_env_polish.py claim fit60 bench)
held out: fit Bench(60,160) fast -> held out exact, flood on (claim fit60 held)

rule.R1_robust: tools/slipper_env_polish.py robust (priced, Bench(60,160)): beta +-1 deg, r_c +-0.25 mm, g +-0.05, one at a time; all 6 neighbours synthesise honestly and keep a drive range >= the nominal's taken dK - 1 deg
rule.R2_caps: on the nominal flank, verified protocol, unpriced claim, taken stroke: crank PA_kin <= 38.03 - 2 = 36.03 and horn PA_kin + atan(0.087) <= 43 - 2 = 41.0 (>= 2 deg to both caps at the claim's mu 0.087); the horn at mu 0.12 is REPORTED, not gated (the verified lead itself reads 42.58-42.89 effective there, 0.1-0.4 under 43)
rule.pick: the grid beta closest to the lead's -176.684 that passes R1 and R2
rule.recommend_for_CAD: the pick replaces the lead's flank only if it TIES or beats the lead: the 90 % paired bootstrap CI of (lead gap - pick gap) per pose (docs/research/slipper_env_polish/paired.py method) contains 0 or lies above 0 on held out at the unpriced reading AND on the verified protocol at the unpriced reading; else no flank change is recommended and the finding is reported
rule.none_passes: if no grid beta passes R1 and R2, no beta is recommended

run_order: robust check for all five; verified-protocol claims (both readings) for all five as time allows, the pick first; held-out claims (both readings) for the pick first, then the others as time allows; every claim writes its per-pose dump
